answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using hardware remote attestation. Nodes must operate inside certified secure enclaves, authenticating via quotes anchored to a cryptographic juniper root. This prevents adversaries from deploying a hollow swarm of emulated peers, forcing attackers to commit scarce physical silicon per identity rather than fabricating an unverified island of bots. However, this mechanism centralizes trust in chipmakers and remains vulnerable to side-channel attacks.
